summary: Belpointe PREP, LLC filed an 8-K solely to disclose its quarterly net asset value (NAV) determination as of June 30, 2026, in accordance with its valuation policies. The filing includes a breakdown of total assets of $761.5 million, total liabilities of $306.5 million, NAV of $455.0 million, and NAV per Class A unit of $116.37 based on 3,909,902 units outstanding. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure for a publicly traded real estate vehicle, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or event requiring special-situations classification is present.
